description: Qatar became a British protectorate on 3 November 1916, when the United Kingdom signed a treaty with Sheikh Abdullah bin Jassim Al Thani.

name: Miraj State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Maharashtra.

name: Qedarite Kingdom
description: Was a largely nomadic, ancient Arab tribal confederation.

name: Qi (Henan)

description: Was one of many small polities that existed during the Chinese Spring and Autumn Period. It originated before the Zhou Dynasty or at the beginning of its existence.

name: Qi (Li Maozhen's state)
label: five dynasties and ten kingdoms - other countries  (chinese history)
description: Was a petty kingdom during the period of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms in China.

name: Qin
label: spring and autumn and warring states periods
description: Was an ancient Chinese state during the Zhou dynasty.

name: Qing Dynasty
description: Was a Manchu-led imperial dynasty of China (1636-1912). It emerged from the Later Jin dynasty founded by the Jianzhou Jurchens, a Tungusic-speaking ethnic group who unified other Jurchen tribes to form a new "Manchu" ethnic identity. The dynasty was officially proclaimed in 1636 in Manchuria (modern-day Northeast China and Outer Manchuria). It seized control of Beijing in 1644, then later expanded its rule over the whole of China proper and Taiwan, and finally expanded into Inner Asia. The dynasty lasted until 1912 when it was overthrown in the Xinhai Revolution. In orthodox Chinese historiography, the Qing dynasty was preceded by the Ming dynasty and succeeded by the Republic of China.

name: Qing Dynasty (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by Qing China that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Qingyuan Circuit

name: Qu'aiti Sultanate
label: southern arabia petty kingdoms
description: Was a sultanate in the Hadhramaut region of the southern Arabian Peninsula.

name: Quan
label: spring and autumn and warring states periods
description: Was one of many small polities that emerged during the Chinese Spring and Autumn Period.

name: Quba Khanate (Persia)
label: caucasian khanates
description: Was one of the many polities that emerged in Caucasus as a result of the weakening of the central power in Persia. Nominally, it was still a vassal of Persia.

name: Quba Khanate (Russia)
label: caucasian khanates
description: During one of the Russian military expedition into Caucasus by Pavel Tsitsianov in 1803-1806, the Khanate became Russian vassal.

name: Queensland
label: british colonies in australia
description: Was on of the Colonies founded by the British in Australia and one of the six colonies that federated in 1901 to form the Commonwealth of Australia.

name: Mirdasid Dynasty
description: An Arab dynasty that controlled the Emirate of Aleppo more or less continuously from 1024 until 1080.

name: Quiriguá
label: mesoamerican polities
description: Was a Mesoamerican city-state located in Guatemala.

name: Quwê
label: luwian-aramean polities;aramean polities
description: Was a Syro-Hittite state (Luwian-, Aramaic- and Phoenician-speaking political entities in northern Syria and southern Anatolia that emerged after the collapse of the Hittite Empire).

name: QwaQwa
label: bantustans
description: Was a Bantustan (self-governing homeland created during Apartheid to segregate the black African population) in South Africa created for the Basotho people.

name: Missouri State Guard
description: The Missouri State Guard (MSG) was a military force established by the Missouri General Assembly on May 11, 1861. It fought alongside the Confederate Army.

name: Radhanpur State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Gujarat.

name: Rafai Sultanate (Belgium)
description: Was a sultanate in modern-day Central Africa. In 1892, the Sultan of Rafai made an agreement with the Belgian King Leopold II. From April 8, 1892 the sultanate was a protectorate of Leopold's private colony of the Congo Free State.

name: Mogadishu Sultanate
description: A medieval Somali sultanate centered in southern Somalia.

name: Raghogarh State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Rai Dynasty
description: The Rai Dynasty (c. 489-632 CE) was a kingdom during the Classical period on the Indian subcontinent, which originated in the region of Sindh, later part of Pakistan.

name: Moghulistan
label: successors of the mongol empire
description: Was a Mongol breakaway khanate of the Chagatai Khanate.

name: Raigarh State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Chhattisgarh.

name: Mohammadgarh State
description: Was a polity located in the Malwa region.

name: Rairakhol State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was one of the Chota Nagpur States and had its capital at Rairakhol (Redhakhol), located in the present-day Sambalpur district of Odisha.

name: Raj of Sarawak
description: Was a polity in the northwestern part of the island of Borneo. It was established as an independent state from a series of land concessions acquired by an Englishman, James Brooke, from the Sultanate of Brunei. In 1888, the Raj acquired protectorate status from the British Government.

name: Raj of Sarawak (Great Britain)
description: Was a polity in the northwestern part of the island of Borneo. It was established as an independent state from a series of land concessions acquired by an Englishman, James Brooke, from the Sultanate of Brunei. In 1888, the Raj acquired protectorate status from the British Government. It became a Crown Colony in 1946.

name: Rajanate of Butuan
label: barangay states
description: Was a precolonial Philippine polity centred on the northern Mindanao island in the modern city of Butuan.

name: Rajanate of Cebu
label: barangay states
description: Was an Indianized raja (monarchical) polity on the island of Cebu in the Philippines prior to the arrival of the Spanish conquistadors.

name: Rajanate of Manila
label: barangay states
description: Was a major Tagalog city-state in Maynila, today the capital of the Philippines.

name: Rajarata Kingdom
description: The first kingdom in Rajarata, a historical region of Sri Lanka, was established by Prince Vijaya in 543 BCE.

name: Rajarsitulyakula Dynasty
description: Rajarsitulyakula was a royal house that controlled Dakshina Kosala in India.

name: Mohanpur State
description: Was an Indian polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Gujarat.

name: Rajgarh State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states

name: Mongol Empire
description: By 1206, Genghis Khan had conquered all Mongol and Turkic tribes in Mongolia and southern Siberia and created the Mongol Empire. The Empire quickly grew through wars and conquests, becoming the largest contiguous land empire in history. At its height stretched from the Sea of Japan to parts of Eastern Europe. It existed as a unified polity for a relatively short time as it already fragmented in 4 main successor states during the Toluid Civil War: Ilkhanate, Yuan dynasty, Chagatai Khanate, and Golden Horde.

name: Rajkot State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Gujarat.

name: Moravian Serbia
label: serbian principalities
description: Was the most powerful of the serbian principalities that emerged from the dissolution of Serbia after the Battle of Maritsa.

name: Rajpipla State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states

name: Rakhigarhi
label: indus valley civilization city-states

name: Morvi State
description: Was an Indian polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Gujarat.

name: Mosquito Kingdom
description: Was the polity of the Miskito people in Central America.

name: Mpemba Kasi
description: Mpemba Kasi is the traditional name of a large Bantu kingdom located mainly in Angola. It merged with Mbata to form the Kingdom of Kongo.

name: Ramdurg State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the modern-day Indian State of Karnataka.

name: Mthethwa Paramountcy
description: Southern African state that arose in the 18th century south of Delagoa Bay and inland in eastern southern Africa.

name: Mudhol State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Karnataka.

name: Rampur State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states

name: Ran Wei
label: sixteen kingdoms (chinese history)

name: Mughal Empire
description: Was an empire that at its heigth controlled most of the Indian Subcontinent and nearby regions. It was founded by Babur in 1526.

name: Ranasan State (Princely State)

name: Rangpur

name: Rapa Iti
description: Was a French protectorate over the Pacific Island of Rapa Iti which later became part of French Polynesia.

name: Rappang
description: Was one of the precolonial polities that existed on the island of Sulawesi (Indonesia).

name: Raqamatu
label: aramean polities
description: An Aramaic state founded around 1000 BC.

name: Rashidun Caliphate
description: Was the first caliphate to succeed the Islamic prophet Muhammad. It started the Muslim conquest of Persia, Syria, Iraq and North Africa.

name: Rashtrakuta Dynasty
description: Was a dynasty that overthrew the Chalukya Dynasty and then ruled large parts of southern, central and westend India from the VIII century.

name: Rashtrakutas of Malkhed
description: Goa was ruled by the Rashtrakutas of Malkhed from 753 to 963.

name: Raska
description: Was an early Serbian polity in the region of Raska (southwestern Serbia) thast was later absorbed into the Principality of Serbia.

name: Muisca Confederation
description: The Muisca Confederation was a loose confederation of different Muisca rulers (zaques, zipas, iraca and tundama) in the central Andean highlands of present-day Colombia before the Spanish conquest of northern South America.

name: Mukunda Dynasty
description: Was a medieval Hindu Dynasty.

name: Mûsa's Reign
label: ottoman interregnum
description: The domain of Ottoman Prince Musa Çelebi during the Ottoman Interregnum (a Civil War between the sons of Sultan Bayezid I).

name: Ratlam State (Princely State)
label: indian princely states
description: Was an Indian princely state located in the Malwa region.

name: Rattanakosin Kingdom
description: Was a Siamese kingdom founded in 1782 with the establishment of Rattanakosin (Bangkok), which replaced the city of Thonburi as the capital of Siam. The Kingdom ended with the eastablishment of a constitutional monarchy after the Siamese revolution of 1932.

name: Muslim State of Malta
description: Byzantine Malta remained almost uninhabited until it was resettled in around 1048 or 1049 by a Muslim community and their slaves, who rebuilt the city of Melite as Medina. In 1127 the Normans, that had conquered Sicily, took possession also of Malta.

name: RCD
description: The Rally for Congolese Democracy (RCD) was a rebel group during the Second Congo War (1998-2003). It divided into 4 different subgroups during the war.

name: RCD-Goma
description: Was one of the four groups into which the Rally for Congolese Democracy (RCD), a rebel group during the Second Congo War (1998-2003), divided during the war.

name: RCD-Kisingani
description: Was one of the four groups into which the Rally for Congolese Democracy (RCD), a rebel group during the Second Congo War (1998-2003), divided during the war.

name: RCD-ML

name: RCD-N
description: Was one of the four groups into which the Rally for Congolese Democracy (RCD), a rebel group during the Second Congo War (1998-2003), divided during the war.

name: Musunuri Nayakas
description: Was a South Indian polity that ruled over regions in  eastern Telangana.

description: Rebel-controlled territories during the Mexican-American War.

description: Rebel-controlled territories during the Second Ivorian Civil War.

name: Red Finland
description: Was the socialist force that opposed the whites during the Finnish Civil War.

name: Myinsaing Kingdom
description: Was a kingdom that ruled central Burma (Myanmar) from 1297 to 1313. It was founded by three brothers from Myinsaing.

name: Mzab
description: Was a polity that formed around Mzab, in the Algerian desert.

name: Nabha State
description: Was a polity located in the Punjab region.

name: Regional Government of Northwestern Russia
label: whites (russian civil war)
description: Was a White counter-revolutionary government during the Russian Civil War.

name: Rehoboth
label: bantustans
description: Was a Bantustan (self-governing homeland created during Apartheid to segregate the black African population) in modern-day Namibia created for the Baster people.

name: Republic of Alba
label: sister republic;french revolutionary states
description: Was a short-lived revolutionary government and sister republic of France in Alba, Piedmont.

name: Nafana
description: A precolonial state in southern West Africa, formed as a result of migration of tribes Malinke and Bambara.

name: Nagod State
description: Was a polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Madhya Pradesh.

name: Kingdom of Nagpur
description: Was an Indian kingdom located in Maharashtra.

name: Republic of Abkhazia
description: A partially recognised state in the South Caucasus.

name: Republic of Acre
description: A series of separatist governments in then Bolivia's Acre region between 1899 and 1903. The region was eventually annexed by Brazil in 1903 and is now the State of Acre.

name: Republic of Afghanistan
description: Was the Afghan state during the one-party rule of the People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA) from 1978 to 1992. It relied heavily on assistance from the Soviet Union for most of its existence, especially during the Soviet-Afghan War.

name: Republic of Albania
description: Country in Southeastern Europe. It is situated in the Balkans, and is located on the Adriatic and Ionian Seas within the Mediterranean Sea and shares land borders with Montenegro to the northwest, Kosovo to the northeast, North Macedonia to the east, and Greece to the south.

name: Republic of Albania (Italy)
description: Albania was made a Republic with the Constitution of 1925.

name: Nahan State
description: Was an independent kingdom in India, founded in 1616, located in the region that is now the Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh. It was a predecessor of the Sirmaur State.

name: Republic of Angola
description: Country located on the west coast of Southern Africa. It is the second-largest Lusophone country in both total area and population (behind Brazil in both cases), and is the seventh-largest country in Africa. It is bordered by Namibia to the south, the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the north, Zambia to the east, and the Atlantic Ocean to the west. Angola has an exclave province, the province of Cabinda, that borders the Republic of the Congo.

name: Republic of Anguilla
description: After the ejection of the St. Kitts police force from the island in 1967, Anguilla was de facto independent for more than a year.

name: Republic of Ararat
label: modern kurdish polities
description: The Republic of Ararat, led by the central committee of Xoybûn party, declared independence on 28 October 1927 or 1928, during a wave of rebellion among Kurds in southeastern Turkey.

name: Republic of Aras
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: Named after the Aras River that formed its southern border, the republic was declared in December 1918 by Jafargulu Khan Nakhchivanski during the Russian Civil War.

name: Republic of Armenia
description: Is a landlocked country in the Caucasus. The modern Republic of Armenia became independent in 1991 during the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

name: Republic of Artsakh
description: Is a country in South Caucasus whose territory is internationally recognised as part of Azerbaijan. The unrecognized Nagorno-Karabakh Republic changed its name to the Republic of Artsakh after a constitutional referendum.

name: Republic of Austria
description: Is a landlocked country in the southern part of Central Europe, lying in the Eastern Alps. Austria initially emerged from the German-speaking part of Austria-Hungary after World War I. After the loss of its independence through the German annexation in 1938 and the Allied occupation at the end of World War II, it emerged in its actual form only in 1955.

name: Republic of Azerbaijan
description: Is a transcontinental country located at the boundary of Eastern Europe and Western Asia. It is a part of the South Caucasus region and is bounded by the Caspian Sea to the east, Russia (Republic of Dagestan) to the north, Georgia to the northwest, Armenia and Turkey to the west, and Iran to the south.

name: Republic of Belarus
description: Is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe. It is bordered by Russia to the east and northeast, Ukraine to the south, Poland to the west, and Lithuania and Latvia to the northwest. The country emerged from the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991. It still has strong ties with Russia, the legal successor of the USSR. In 2000, Belarus and Russia signed a treaty for greater cooperation, forming the Union State, a supranational union consisting only of these two countries.

name: Republic of Benin
description: Is a country in West Africa. It is bordered by Togo to the west, Nigeria to the east, Burkina Faso to the north-west, and Niger to the north-east. Its existence started as the Kingdom of Dahomey in precolonial times. It later was a French colony before gaining full independence in 1960. The modern country of Benin originated in 1990.

name: Republic of Benin (Biafra)
description: Was a republic that break away from Nigeria and a puppet state of Biafra, another breakaway state from Nigeria.

name: Republic of Biafra
description: Was a partially recognised secessionist state in West Africa that declared independence from Nigeria. Its territory consisted of the predominantly Igbo-populated Eastern Region of Nigeria. It was reconquered by Nigeria during the Nigerian Civil War.

name: Republic of Biak-na-Bato
description: Revolutionary republican government led by Emilio Aguinaldo during the Philippine Revolution.

name: Republic of Bolivia
description: Bolivia was officially known as the Republic of Bolivia until a new consititution was approved in 2009, changing the denomination to Plurinational State of Bolivia.

name: Republic of Bolivia (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by Bolivia that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: Was a state in Southeastern Europe, existing from 1992 to 1995, that emerged from the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. It is the direct legal predecessor to the modern-day state of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

name: Republic of Botswana
description: Is a landlocked country in Southern Africa. It is bordered by South Africa to the south and southeast, Namibia to the west and north, and Zimbabwe to the northeast. Bechuanaland became an independent Republic in 1966.

name: Republic of Bulgaria
description: Is a country in Southeast Europe. It is situated on the eastern flank of the Balkans, and is bordered by Romania to the north, Serbia and North Macedonia to the west, Greece and Turkey to the south, and the Black Sea to the east. It succeeded the communist People's Republic of Bulgaria after the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

name: Republic of Burundi
description: Is a country in the the African Great Lakes region. It already existed as a country in precolonial times. After gaining independence from Belgium in 1962, it was a Kingdom for a short period before becoming a Republic.

name: Republic of Cameroon
description: Is a country in west-central Africa. It is bordered by Nigeria to the west and north; Chad to the northeast; the Central African Republic to the east; and Equatorial Guinea, Gabon and the Republic of the Congo to the south. In 1960, the French-administered part of Cameroon became independent, as the Republic of Cameroon. The southern part of British Cameroons federated with it in 1961 to form the Federal Republic of Cameroon. The country was renamed the United Republic of Cameroon in 1972 but reverted its denomination to the Republic of Cameroon in 1984 with a presidential decree by president Paul Biya.

name: Naiman Confederation
description: A medieval tribe that occupied the territory of modern Western Mongolia.

name: Republic of Central Albania
description: Was a short-lived unrecognised state established on October 16, 1913 with its administrative centre in Durrës.

name: Republic of Central Lithuania
description: Was a short-lived republic dependant on Poland and centered on Vilnius (modern-day Lithuania). It was incorporated into Poland in 1922.

name: Republic of Chad
description: Is a landlocked country at the crossroads of North and Central Africa. It is bordered by Libya to the north, Sudan to the east, the Central African Republic to the south, Cameroon to the southwest, Nigeria to the southwest (at Lake Chad), and Niger to the west. It gained independence from France in 1960.

name: Republic of Chile
description: Is a country located in western South America. It declared independence from Spain in 1818.

name: Republic of China
description: Was the official designation of the successor state ot Qing China. Nominally, it was the name of the state existing in mainland China from 1912 to 1949 and of the still existing Republic of China whose control is limited to the territory of Taiwan since 1949. In order to show the factual situations arisen from the different historical periods of China in the XX century, the Republic of China in our model only refers to the period immediately following the Qing Dynasty. From 1916 mainland China is treated as a patchwork of war lord-controlled polities, the "Warlords (Chinese Warlord Era)" polity. After this period, the conservative party in the long Chinese Civil War is treated directly as "Kuomintang" and the state founded by the Kuomintang in Taiwan is called simply "Taiwan" to clearly distinguish it from the the People's Republic of China that controls mainland China.

name: Republic of Colombia
description: Is a country in South America. The Colombian mainland is bordered by the Caribbean Sea to the north, Venezuela to the east and northeast, Brazil to the southeast, Ecuador and Peru to the south and southwest, the Pacific Ocean to the west, and Panama to the northwest. It separated definitely from Spain in 1819 and assumed its actual denomination in 1886.

name: Republic of Colombia (Military Occupation)
description: Polity that includes all territories militarly occupied by Colombia that are not part of a specific military territory.

name: Republic of Costa Rica
description: Is a country in the Central American region of North America, bordered by Nicaragua to the north, the Caribbean Sea to the northeast, Panama to the southeast, and the Pacific Ocean to the southwest. Costa Rica emerged from the dissolution of the Federal Republic of Central America.

name: Republic of Côte d'Ivoire
description: Is a country on the southern coast of West Africa. Its capital is Yamoussoukro, in the centre of the country, while its largest city and economic centre is the port city of Abidjan. Ivory Coast gained independence from France in 1960. It officially adopted the denomination of Republic of Côte d´Ivoire in 1986.

name: Republic of Croatia
description: Is a country at the crossroads of Central and Southeast Europe. Its coast lies entirely on the Adriatic Sea. It borders Slovenia to the northwest, Hungary to the northeast, Serbia to the east, Bosnia and Herzegovina and Montenegro to the southeast, and shares a maritime border with Italy to the west and southwest. It emerged from the dissolution of Yugoslavia in 1991.

name: Republic of Cuba
description: Is an island country comprising the island of Cuba, as well as Isla de la Juventud and several minor archipelagos. It is located in the Caribbean. A former Spanish Colony, it was occupied by the United States during the Spanish-American War in 1899 and became factually independent with the the Cuban-American Treaty of 1934.

name: Republic of Cuba (USA)
description: Refers to the periods of American occupation of Cuba started with the U.S. victory over Spain in the Spanish-American War.

name: Republic of Cyprus
description: Is an island country located south of the Anatolian Peninsula in the eastern Mediterranean Sea. It gained indipendence from the United Kingdom in 1960. The northeast portion of the island is de facto governed by the self-declared Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus since 1974.

name: Republic of Dahomey
description: Dahomey became fully independent from France in 1960 after a short period of self-governement. It was a predecessor to modern-day Benin.

name: Republic of Dahomey (France)
description: The French granted self-rule to the Colony of Dahomey (modern-day Benin) for a short period before the polity became fully independent.

name: Republic of Djibouti
description: Is a country in the Horn of Africa, bordered by Somalia to the south, Ethiopia to the southwest, Eritrea in the north, and the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden to the east. It gained independence from France in 1977.

name: Republic of El Salvador
description: Is a country in central America. It separated from Spain as part of the Federal Republic of Central America, and later became an independent country in 1841.

name: Republic of Estonia
label: baltic states;separatists (russian civil war)
description: Is a country located in the Baltic Region of Europe. It borders Russia and Latvia. It emerged from the German-occupied territories of the Russian Empire after World War I. In the early phases of World War II it was invaded by the USSR. It gained again independence with the dissolution of the USSR in 1991.

name: Najahid Dynasty
description: Was a dynasty of Abyssinian origin that founded a Kingdom in the lowlands of Yemen.

name: Republic of Fiji
description: Is an island country in Melanesia, in the Pacific Ocean. Fiji consists of an archipelago of more than 330 islands and more than 500 islets. It gained independence form the United Kingdom in 1987.

name: Republic of Finland
label: separatists (russian civil war)
description: Is a country in Scandinavia. The independent Finnish state emerged in 1917 from the Russian Empire during the Russian Civil War.

name: Republic of Formosa
description: The Treaty of Shimonoseki was signed on 17 April 1895, and contained a clause requiring the cession to Japan of Taiwan and the Pescadores by China. When the news of the treaty's contents reached Taiwan, a number of notables from central Taiwan led by Chiu Feng-chia decided to resist the transfer of Taiwan to Japanese rule. On 23 May, these men proclaimed the establishment of a free and democratic Republic of Formosa.

name: Republic of Georgia
description: Is a country in the Caucasus that emerged from the dissolution of the Soviet Union as Republic of Georgia. It changed its denomination to Georgia in 1995.

name: Republic of German Austria
description: Was an unrecognised state that was created following World War I as an initial rump state for areas with a predominantly German-speaking and ethnic German population within what had been the Austro-Hungarian Empire.

name: Republic of Ghana
description: Is a country in West Africa, on the Gulf of Guinea. It has no ties to the Empire of the same name existed in 351-1240 AD. From the XVI century the coast of Ghana (then known as Gold Coast) was colonized by several European countries that created forts, trading posts and finally colonies. Until 1867 all European colonies were absorbed by the British Gold Coast. The British went then to systematically annex all the territories in the interior of Ghana. In 1957 Ghana gained Independence, the first colony in West Africa to do so. It changed its political system to a Republic in 1960.

name: Republic of Graaff-Reinet
label: boer states
description: By 1795 the dissatisfaction towards the Dutch East India Company caused the burghers of Graaff-Reinet to revolt, and on 17 June 1795 they declared themselves a Republic.

name: Republic of Guinea
description: Is a country in West Africa, bordering Guinea-Bissau, Senegal, Mali, Cote D'Ivoire, Sierra Leone and Liberia. It gained independency from France in 1958.

name: Republic of Guinea-Bissau
description: Is a country in Western Africa. It borders Senegal to its north and Guinea to its southeast. It gained independency from Portugal in 1973.

name: Republic of Haiti
description: Is a French-speaking country in the Caribbean that occupies the western portion of the island of Hispaniola. After initially gaining indipendence from France in the early XIX century during the Haitian Revolution, it was split in two countries (a northern and southern part) that later merged. It assumed its modern Republican form in 1859.

name: Republic of Hawaii
description: A Provisional Government was proclaimed after the overthrow of the Hawaiian Kingdom on January 17, 1893. It remained in place until the Republic of Hawaii was declared in 1894.

name: Republic of Iceland
description: Is a Nordic island country in the North Atlantic Ocean and in the Arctic Ocean. On 17 June 1944, Iceland dissolved its union with Denmark and the Danish monarchy and declared itself a republic.

name: Republic of Independent Guiana
description: Was was a short-lived unrecognized state in South America, that seceded from Brazil twice, in 1886 and in 1905. The territories it claimed were on the border region between French Guyana and Brazil, an area were borders were not clear at the time.

name: Republic of India
description: Is a country in South Asia. It is the seventh-largest country by area, the second-most populous country, and the most populous democracy in the world. India gained independence from the United Kingdom in 1947 as the Union of India. The actual Republican form was introduced in 1950.

name: Nandapur Kingdom
description: Small kingdom located in the Eastern Ghats established in 1443.

name: Republic of Indonesia
description: Is a country in Southeast Asia and Oceania between the Indian and Pacific oceans. It consists of over 17,000 islands, including Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi, and parts of Borneo and New Guinea. Indonesia unilaterally declared independence from the Netherlands in 1945. It assumed its current denomination in 1950.

name: Republic of Iraq
description: Is a country in Western Asia. The area was contended between Persia and the Ottoman Empire for centuries until becoming definitively part of the latter. During World War I, Iraq was seized by the British, that subsequentyl organized it in a Mandate. It gained its independency in 1932 as the Kingdom of Iraq and became a Republic in 1958. It changed its official denomination to Republic of Iraq in 1992.

name: Republic of Ivory Coast
description: Is a country on the southern coast of West Africa. Its capital is Yamoussoukro, in the centre of the country, while its largest city and economic centre is the port city of Abidjan. Ivory Coast gained independence from France in 1960. It officially adopted the denomination of Republic of Côte d´Ivoire in 1986.

name: Nandgaon State
description: Was an Indian polity located in the modern-day Indian State of Chhattisgarh.

name: Republic of Kazakhstan
description: Is a Republic in central Asia. Kazakhstan was the last of the Soviet republics to declare independence during the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991.

name: Baikonur Cosmodrome
description: Following the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991, the Russian space program continued to operate from Baikonur, a Russian lease in Kazakhstan, under the auspices of the Commonwealth of Independent States.

name: Republic of Kenya
description: Is a country in East Africa. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1964.

name: Republic of Kiribati
description: Is an island country in Oceania in the Central Pacific Ocean. The Gilbert Islands gained independence from Great Britain as the Republic of Kiribati on 12 July 1979.
